supporting_observations.claim: At 13:42:53 UTC, DC-RB-01 recorded cole.price being added to the group named Remote Desktop Users by dev.sharma, using subject logon ID 0x7a76dca.
The group-change logon ID matches a dev.sharma Kerberos network logon to DC-RB-01 at 13:40:15 UTC from 10.60.10.22.

The change is inconsistent with the supplied policy restricting Remote Desktop Users membership to IT: cole.price is identified as a vet tech. The supplied calendar's planned group change concerns hana.ito and Billing-Share, not this membership addition. This makes the alerted change suspicious but does not establish malicious intent.

The alerted change's associated network logon originated from 10.60.10.22, whereas observed outbound connections identify WS-DSHARMA-01 as 10.60.10.23. The supplied records do not establish which host owned 10.60.10.22.

At 13:43:55 UTC, Explorer on WS-CPRICE-01 updated a cole.price UserAssist entry whose ROT13-decoded path is C:\Windows\System32\mstsc.exe. This is consistent with RDP-client use shortly after the addition, but does not identify a destination or establish a successful connection.
The successful FILE-RB-01 RDP logon shown nearby belongs to dev.sharma from WS-DSHARMA-01 at 10.60.10.23, not cole.price. It does not demonstrate use of cole.price's new membership.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied collection status reports proxy logs unavailable on PROXY-RB-01 from 13:30 through 14:15 UTC. This limits web-activity visibility but does not obscure the recorded group addition.
The supplied evidence contains no initiating group-management command or process for S27-00048; S27-00047 provides an associated network-logon source, not a verified source-host identity.
The UserAssist value in S27-00060 contains no RDP destination or connection outcome.
claims_not_established: Whether dev.sharma personally authorized and performed the addition, made an administrative mistake, or had the account misused.
Whether an approved ticket or exception exists for the cole.price membership change.
Which host owned 10.60.10.22 at the time of the logon associated with the change.
Whether cole.price successfully used the added membership for remote access.
Credential theft, account compromise, persistence intent, and malicious lateral movement are not established.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain the change ticket and independently confirm the purpose and authorization of S27-00048 with dev.sharma.
Resolve 10.60.10.22 using contemporaneous DHCP, IPAM, or endpoint inventory records, then correlate its authentication and process telemetry with DC logon ID 0x7a76dca.
Collect directory-management, PowerShell, and endpoint process records identifying the command or tool that performed the membership addition.
Collect RDP client and destination-server authentication/session records for cole.price following 13:42:53 UTC.
Verify the changed group's directory identity, effective permissions, and current membership; coordinate removal if the addition is confirmed unauthorized.
